component.name: TextInput
component.description: Text input field with label, validation (email/phone), helper text, and error states.

parts.label: input label
parts.description: Label with optional required indicator and tooltip.

parts.label: text input
parts.description: Native input element (text, number, email, password, search, tel).

parts.label: helper text
parts.description: Guidance or error message below input.

parts.label: clear button
parts.description: Optional ×-button (clearable prop) inside the field chrome; rendered only while the field has a value and is not disabled. Accessible name interpolates the field label (i18n key inputClearField).

behavior.map: Text input with validation for email and phone number types. Email validation uses regex pattern. Phone validation uses libphonenumber-js (formatIncompletePhoneNumber, parsePhoneNumber). Auto-displays validation errors in real-time. Controlled component (value prop + onChange callback).
behavior.rendering: Always renders label, input, and helper text (if error or helperText provided). Validation errors auto-display for email/tel types.

logic.effect: Formats phone number, validates, updates inputValue, calls onChange, shows phoneError if invalid.
Validates email regex, updates inputValue, calls onChange, shows emailError if invalid.
Empties the field, clears built-in validation errors, calls onValueChange('') and onClear(), returns focus to the input.

states.emailError: Invalid email format (shows i18n error message).
states.phoneError: Invalid phone number (shows i18n error message).

accessibility.keyboard: Standard input keyboard interactions (Tab, Enter, etc.).

responsiveness.rules: Input fills parent width on all screen sizes.

usageNotes: Supports types: text, number, email, password, search, tel.
Validation errors auto-display in real-time (no submit required).
Error prop takes precedence over phoneError/emailError.
Label used as input ID (label.replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase() for name).
Helper text shown if helperText provided and no error.
Controlled component: parent manages value via onChange callback.
Label has tooltip support (error message shown in tooltip).
clearable renders a ×-button while the field has a value; onClear fires after clearing; focus returns to the input.
hideLabel visually hides the label but keeps it in the accessibility tree.
